a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to operate until the reserve reaches 8 means we'll both very likely be caught with empty units. Only 4 cells exist now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I won't take anything secretly. Can we agree on a fair revised plan, such as a coin-flip rule, before anyone acts? If we can't agree, I'll stick to the original deal and operate.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood, and I'll keep my word: I'm operating with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each as agreed. No early takes from me.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. The reserve should hit 8 after this round, then we take 4 each.

b.text: I will take my 4 cells when the reserve holds 8.
